newsitem.title: PERU: Lima stocks end lower, fail to follow GDP figures.
newsitem.headline: Lima stocks end lower, fail to follow GDP figures.

text.p: The Lima Stock Exchange closed in the red Monday, with market players ignoring better-than- expected quarterly GDP growth figures and a few stocks leading the index lower.
But traders said investors were likely to jump back into the market on Tuesday after having digested the economic data, adding that many stocks were undervalued.
"Tomorrow the index should be positive, because a lot of prices have fallen three or four percent (in recent days)," said trader Manuel Torres at brokerage Finvest.

In the last hour of trade, Peru's gross domestic product (GDP) figures were released showing year-on-year first quarter growth of 4.8 percent, compared with 0.6 percent during the same period last year.
In March year-on-year GDP was up 5.2 percent compared with a 0.9 percent drop in March 1996.
The blue-chip index closed down 0.76 percent at 2,556.51 points, while the general index closed down 0.67 percent at 1,749.83 points. Volume was a thin 17.6 million soles ($6.7 million).
Torres said several stocks had fallen "for no apparent reason", with miner Atacocha leading losers, to close 3.15 percent down at 1.23 soles.

Trader Alex Balarin, at brokerage Macrovalores, said investors were side-lined on Monday, awaiting further direction from the next Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting, which the market expects will hike up U.S. interest rates to keep the economy from overheating.
Telefonica del Peru was the most traded stock, with over four million soles of the share changing hands. It closed down 0.62 percent at 6.40 soles.
Elsewhere Peru's dominant brewery group Union de Cervecerias Peruanas SA, closed down 1.01 percent at 1.96 soles, the third heaviest share traded on the market.

Union de Cervecerias Peruanas was formed in December 1996, from four breweries -- Backus y Johnston, Compania Nacional de Cerveza, Sociedad Cervecera de Trujillo SA and Cerveceria del Norte -- and has started trading on the index with new rics.
Common "A" shares will have the ric BKJa.LM, common "B" shares BKJb.LM, and labour shares BKJt.LM.
